summary: Prepare verified native scalar counters for repeated calls

delivery.outcome: Provide an explicit prepared native scalar callable that audits artifacts at preparation and binds native function/library for repeated calls; preserve existing APIs and prove same-wheel compiled64B steady-state >=20x speedup with preparation measured separately. Independently publish/merge and preserve/release owned worktree.
nonGoals: Change existing scalar/many/stream checks/behavior, Rust/C ABI, dependencies or platform support.
Revalidate files on every prepared call, implement process hot reload, change generic consumer backends, claim real nl-* workload or Rust speedup.
Publish registry release/deploy, migrate consumers or bypass protected delivery.

architecture.decision: Add prepare_ascii_token_counter returning Callable[[bytes], int]. Validate backend eagerly; compiled preparation uses existing verified native loader and requires a callable scalar entry; Rust preparation explicitly audits artifacts then binds existing ABI-checked kernel. Private slotted callable retains native entry/CDLL, normalizes bytes subclasses from actual buffer, passes ordinary bytes unchanged and owns fresh uint64 output per Rust call. Prepared calls keep the binding without filesystem verification; explicit verify/new preparation audits drift. Existing APIs unchanged; process loader caches do not hot-reload. Reproduce warm timing and constructor costs in an installed-wheel benchmark; thresholds stay outside CI.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected independent review; preserve previous local dist, baseline/timing receipts and all generated worktree data before cleanup.

validation.evidence: Eager invalid-backend/missing artifacts/entry failures; bound lookup, actual-buffer normalization, plain-bytes identity, FFI error and retained CDLL lifetime; installed both-backend random/subclass/empty/threaded parity; safe header drift snapshot semantics and fresh audit rejection without editing loaded .so.

>=20x median compiled-python prepared vs existing public scalar for64B in same wheel,7 warmed series, construction cost separate; correctness and hashes/environment bound. No CPU affinity or nl-* claim and no CI timing threshold. Full suites and final build/export/installed smoke pass.

Canonical standardv15 metadata/index/tracking, explicit preparation integrity/lifetime/cache contract and exact source/receipts; local/required remote gates, frozen independent approval/merge, owner release and preserved exact worktree cleanup/audit.
